1557-1719-4613.easyPrerequisites:
Siren of the Silent Song doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Vizier of Tumbling Sands is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
1557-1719-4613.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1557-1719-4613.description:
Activate Siren of the Silent Song using Vizier of Tumbling Sands's ability by tapping it, untapping another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the other creature using Vizier of Tumbling Sands's ability by tapping it, untapping Siren of the Silent Song
Siren of the Silent Song triggers, causing each opponent to discard and mill a card.
Repeat.

2226-2397-6408.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-2397-6408.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Panharmonicon.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Storm Sculptor by paying its mana cost.
When Storm Sculptor enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

1479-2841-5702-6926.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Vibrant Cityscape.
1479-2841-5702-6926.description:
Fetch a land using Vibrant Cityscape.
When the fetched land enters, Springheart Nantuko and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

240-5470-6495-7060.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat from step 2.
240-5470-6495-7060.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

6732-7841-8089.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is a multiple of 3.
6732-7841-8089.description:
Activate Souldrinker by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

586-864-2267-2921-3125.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2267-2921-3125.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Tormod.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

277-880-7889.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
277-880-7889.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Tiller Engine.
When the land enters the battlefield, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1999-3139-3263-7340.easyPrerequisites: Master Transmuter does not have summoning sickness.
1999-3139-3263-7340.description:
Activate The Great Henge by tapping it, gaining 2 life and adding {G}{G} which you can spend to activate Master Transmuter due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {U}, tapping it, and returning The Great Henge from the battlefield to your hand, putting Sewer-veillance Cam from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Sewer-veillance Cam enters, it triggers, allowing you to untap Master Transmuter.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {U}, tapping it, and returning Sewer-veillance Cam from the battlefield to your hand, putting The Great Henge from your hand onto the vattlefield.
When Sewer-veillance Cam leaves the battlefield, it triggers, allowing you to untap Master Transmuter.
Repeat.

4399-4506-4518-5998.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Auriok Champion trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Auriok Champion trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4506-4518-5998.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

4210-6824-7690.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4210-6824-7690.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
When the Wall enters, Pious Evangel triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.
4210-6824-7690.notes: The +1/+1 counter can be placed on any Hero you control except Invisible Woman. Spider-Man is used above for simplicity.

2104-4423-6886-7705.easyPrerequisites:
You control three other Islands.
There is another nonbasic land on the battlefield.
2104-4423-6886-7705.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Dust Bowl by paying {3}, tapping it and sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, destroying a nonbasic land.
Play Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Temporal Manipulation during your draw step.
Repeat.

1172-1624-5858.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, cast Channel by paying {G}{G}.
Activate Channel by paying 1 life, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 until you have exactly 1 life.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

2981-3497-4907-6989.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 3 life this turn.
2981-3497-4907-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Ezzaroot Channeler. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

240-2079-2292-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat from step 2.

628-2193-2829.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Chainbreaker.
When Chainbreaker dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6798-6972-7155.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Arcbound Fiend.
When Arcbound Fiend dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Fiend's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Fiend from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

527-1849-5900.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{U}.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Selvala.
Repeat.

3095-3661-6871.description:
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
When Shield Sphere enters, Overburden triggers, causing you to return Shield Sphere from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph.
Repeat.

2904-5638.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Equipment.
2904-5638.description:
Activate Plate Armor's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Cephalid Illusionist.
Cephalid Illusionist triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Resolve the Plate Armor ability, attaching it to Cephalid Illusionist.
Repeat.

2350-3532-3594-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Toothy triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

198-1978-4241.description:
Animate Empowered Autogenerator using Karn.
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {1} for each charge counter on it.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat from step 2.
198-1978-4241.notes: The combo assumes Empowered Autogenerator has no charge counters on it when you start. If it has charge counters, the mana cost is reduced by {1}.

4740-5670-6742.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 4 or higher, plus an additional 2 life if you cast Timeline Culler using its warp ability.
4740-5670-6742.description:
Cast Timeline Culler from your hand by paying {B}{B} or from your graveyard or hand for its warp cost by paying {B} and 2 life.
Aetherflux Reservoir, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Timeline Culler, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
4740-5670-6742.notes: The amount of life and mana you need to start the combo varies based on how many spells you've cast this turn and where Timeline Culler starts. The life pre-requisite assumes you've cast no spells this turn. If you start by casting Timeline Culler using its warp ability, the starting mana will be {B} instead. Once you have infinite life, you can activate Aetherflux Reservoir to deal damage.

413-3558-5220-6900.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds
When Crookshank Kobolds dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
When Crookshank Kobolds enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

1491-2757-6702.description:
Activate a basic Iand by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Kilo.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a +1/+1 counter on Kilo.
Resolve the Earthcraft ability, untapping a basic land.
Activate Kilo by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

1690-2538-5034-6289.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand that can be cast for {0} due to Voyager Quickwelder.
1690-2538-5034-6289.description:
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast an artifact by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning Sol Ring to your hand.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Sol Ring by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning the artifact cast in step 3 to your hand.
Repeat.
1690-2538-5034-6289.notes: You can use an artifact creature to get infinite ETB and LTB triggers. If you do not use a creature, this combo will not produce those results.

1306-1690-2146-2538.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand that can be cast for {0} due to Cloud Key.
1306-1690-2146-2538.description:
Activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast an artifact by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning Mana Crypt to your hand.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Mana Crypt by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning the artifact cast in step 3 to your hand.
Repeat.
1306-1690-2146-2538.notes: You can use a historic creature to get infinite ETB and LTB triggers. If you do not use a creature, this combo will not produce those results.

4863-4871-5231-6476.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents that each have a creature card that will enter the battlefield with greater than 0 toughness in their graveyard.
4863-4871-5231-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}, returning Revolutionist and at least three other creatures from graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Revolutionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Afterlife from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Thermopod four times by sacrificing four of the creatures returned in step 1, including Revolutionist, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1329-2178-3661-5231.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-2178-3661-5231.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Shield Sphere, adding {R}.
When Shield Sphere dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Repeat.

1479-3678-5621.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3678-5621.description:
Play Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it, Retreat to Emeria, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Emeria trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

3240-4050-6112.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Nether Traitor, adding {B}.
When Nether Traitor dies, Fumulus triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature token dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1636-5627-5671.notablePrerequisites:
Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
1636-5627-5671.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, The Necrobloom triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

969-3259-3709.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to any creature you control.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
969-3259-3709.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker.
Rabble Rousing triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Citizen creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Human Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1818-2173-4050-5010.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 3.
1818-2173-4050-5010.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
When Golgari Thug enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

1634-3858-4507.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers.
Holding priority, cast March of the Multitudes with X=5 by tapping Devilish Valet and by paying at most {4}{G}{W}{W}, creating five 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
When the Soldiers enter the battlefield, Devilish Valet triggers five times, doubling its power five times, causing its power to be at least 32 until end of turn.
Resolve the Mayael's Aria trigger, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain 10 life and win the game.

2-1651-1822-4563.notablePrerequisites:
Everflowing Chalice has at least four charge counters on it.
You control a nontoken noncreature artifact with mana value less than or equal to the number of charge counters on Everflowing Chalice minus four.
2-1651-1822-4563.description:
Activate Everflowing Chalice by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate Clock of Omens by tapping the nontoken noncreature artifact and Ancestral Statue, untapping Everflowing Chalice.
Resolve both Ancestral Statue triggers, returning it and the nontoken noncreature artifact to your hand.
Cast the noncreature artifact by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the noncreature artifact has a mana value less than the number of charge counters on Everflowing Chalice minus four, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.

1409-3426-4050.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Deranged Hermit.
1409-3426-4050.description:
Activate Deranged Hermit by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deranged Hermit enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator triggers.
Resolve the Deranged Hermit trigger, creating four 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Deranged Hermit.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing two Squirrels, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2872-4056-4639.notablePrerequisites:
Second Wind attached to Clever Conjurer.
Clever Conjurer does not have summoning sickness.
2872-4056-4639.description:
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, targeting Second Wind.
Clever Conjurer triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Clever Conjurer ability, untapping Second Wind.
Activate Second Wind's second ability by tapping it, untapping Clever Conjurer.
Repeat.

2558-4303-4659-4694-4854.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, adding {C}{C}.
Sword of the Meek dies, triggering Slagstone Refinery, creating a tapped Powerstone token that enters the battlefield as a 1/1 creature due to March of the Machines and Chief of the Foundry.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield, but not attaching itself to the Powerstone due to Sword of the Meek becoming a creature.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-1858-5195.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}, targeting Birgi.
Birgi and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve View from Above, giving Birgi flying until end of turn and returning View from Above to your hand.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

1494-2744-4428-4840.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Myr Battlesphere.
Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cathars' Crusade.
Resolve the Myr Battlesphere trigger, creating four 1/1 Myr creature tokens.
The Myr tokens enter the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade four times.
Resolve all Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting five +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

231-2104-2478-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three other Islands.
231-2104-2478-4423.description:
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, looking at the top card of a player's library and drawing a card at the beginning of the next turn's upkeep.
Activate Tameshi by paying {W} and returning Mystic Sanctuary to your hand, returning Mishra's Bauble from graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Play Mystic Sanctuary.
Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield, putting Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to the top of your library.
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying {0}.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mishra's Bauble triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
